quote: The catalogue maintenance proves that up to 5,000 hourly buckets sum to their totals, and that both storage families agree on versions per worker and hour.

quote: Staging is five machines: two workers and three storage nodes.

quote: The stamper holds at most 20,000 clusters per worker and drops the least recently used.
